components.css: .ds-project-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.5s ease-in-out, background-color 0.5s ease-in-out; } .ds-project-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)) 20%, transparent); } .ds-project-media { aspect-ratio: 16/9; margin: -24px -24px 0; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375)) 30%, transparent); } .ds-project-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-project-head h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-project-head time { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)); } .ds-project-desc { margin: 0; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)); } .ds-project-foot { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32)); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938)); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio reads like a precise, well-kept engineering ledger. Content sits inside ruled cells and hairline-bordered grids; monospace annotations label everything the way a spec sheet labels its rows; and the whole surface stays near-monochrome so a single live emerald signal can mean something when it appears. The personality is precise and confident — restraint that reads as competence, not timidity. Two shape languages coexist on purpose: structural content is rectilinear and border-drawn, while interactive chrome is fully rounded. Depth is flat by doctrine — surfaces rest on the page and are separated by borders, not shadows, with shadow reserved for things that genuinely float or respond to a pointer. The explicit anti-reference is the generic gradient SaaS template.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome zinc canvas; emerald is the one live signal, and it is rare.
Monospace (JetBrains Mono) for labels, metrics, and annotations; Montserrat for everything read as prose.
Border-drawn grids and cells instead of shadowed panels.
Sharp corners for content, full-round pills for controls.
Motion is a single, calm reveal — never decorative churn.

rules.name: The Split-Primary Rule
rules.body: primary is Graphite Ink in light mode and Signal Emerald in dark mode. Never hardcode green for accents in light mode, and never assume the accent is green regardless of theme — bind to the primary token and let the theme decide.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald (and the availability green) together occupy a tiny fraction of any screen. If accent color starts appearing on more than a handful of elements per viewport, it has stopped being a signal.

rules.name: The Monospace-Annotation Rule
rules.body: Anything that labels, measures, or timestamps is JetBrains Mono, uppercase where it's an eyebrow or caption. Prose and headings are never monospace.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Structural surfaces are flat and bordered at rest. Elevation is earned by floating (the navbar) or by a pointer (hover), never applied decoratively to a static card.

dos: Do bind accents to the primary token so the Split-Primary Rule holds (Graphite Ink in light, Signal Emerald in dark).
Do draw structure with hairline border-border grids and cells; keep structural surfaces flat.
Do use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, for eyebrows, metrics, timestamps, and status — and Montserrat for all prose and headings.
Do keep the two shape languages honest: sharp corners for content, rounded-full for interactive chrome.
Do reveal content with the single 0.8s fade-up on scroll, staggered — one calm reveal, not competing animations.
Do reserve elevation for the floating navbar and pointer hover.
donts: Don't hardcode green for accents in light mode, or assume the accent is green regardless of theme.
Don't spend emerald (or the availability green) on more than a few elements per viewport — its rarity is the signal.
Don't reach for gradient hero washes, glassmorphism, or generic SaaS-template polish; the bordered monospace precision is the identity.
Don't add drop shadows to static cards to create depth — use borders and tonal fills.
Don't round the sharp-cornered content cells (stats, project cards) or square off the pills (nav, CTA, badges).
Don't set body copy or headings in the monospace font.
